findings.rule: the part talked about is lit / steady colour-matched highlights
findings.problem: On "A surd times itself", the whole bottom of the (√5)² − (√3)² line turns sky, so the orange √5 (a) and sky √3 (b) from the line before lose their colours. The voice then names root five squared and root three squared one at a time, but nothing marks which is which.
findings.fix: Drop the whole-bottom sky highlight. Keep (√5)² orange and (√3)² sky, and on "five" and "three" light the 5 orange and the 3 sky in 5 − 3, so each square is matched to its number.
